title: Unit 4-cubes in a 4-cube, k = 17 to 30: packings with exact certificates
4 次元の立方体に単位 4 次元立方体 k = 17〜30 個：厳密な証明書付きの配置
lead: Upper bounds for \(s_4(k)\), \(17 \le k \le 30\), by packings with exact certificates checked by two independent checkers: sides \(2 + 1/\sqrt3\), \(2 + 1/\sqrt2\) and \(2 + 2\sqrt2/3\) in quadratic fields for \(k \le 29\), and a rational side \(2.9876881\) for \(k = 30\). For \(k = 27\) to \(30\) the sides are below the published values. The packing for \(k = 25\) is a product of two 5-square packings; \(k = 18\)–\(24\) and \(26\)–\(28\) are nested subsets of \(k = 25\) and \(29\).

\(17 \le k \le 30\) の \(s_4(k)\) の上界を、独立な 2 つの検査器で検査した厳密な証明書付きの配置で示す。\(k \le 29\) は 2 次体の辺 \(2 + 1/\sqrt3\)、\(2 + 1/\sqrt2\)、\(2 + 2\sqrt2/3\)、\(k = 30\) は有理数の辺 \(2.9876881\)。\(k = 27\)〜\(30\) では辺が公開値より小さい。\(k = 25\) の配置は 5 個の正方形の配置 2 つの積で、\(k = 18\)〜\(24\) と \(26\)〜\(28\) はそれぞれ \(k = 25\) と \(29\) の配置の入れ子である。
author: Hiroaki Hosono (wand125)

versions.en: First version: s₄(17) ≤ 2 + 1/√3, s₄(k) ≤ 2 + 1/√2 for 18 ≤ k ≤ 25, s₄(k) ≤ 2 + 2√2/3 for 26 ≤ k ≤ 29 (certificates of Release cubes-n-dim-n4-certs-v3), s₄(30) ≤ 2.9876881 (Release cubes-n-dim-n4k30-v1).
